description: Upload an image to BasePic and get links: page_url (short link to share), image_url (direct image) and download_url. Give either a public "url" (an image, or a post on X/Instagram/Facebook) or "image_base64". Returns an id for edit_image and a delete_key. Images up to 50 MB. The image is private: only people with the link can see it.

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (a data: URL works too)

return_preview.description: Also return a small preview of the image so you can look at it (default false)

url.description: Public https link to the image

name: upload_image
title: Upload image
